display.purpose: Hero name and large section headings.

body.purpose: Body copy, navigation, and interface labels.

motion.name: editorial-link-transition
motion.purpose: Color transition on the pricing action link.

motion.name: image-carousel-scroll
motion.purpose: Continuous gallery motion, disabled for reduced motion and paused on hover or focus.

components.name: Pricing Action Link
components.description: Primary action link styled as a squared blue button.
components.css: .ds-pricing-link { display: inline-flex; min-height: 3.25rem; align-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--brand-blue); background: var(--brand-blue); padding: 0 1.35rem; color: #fff; font: 700 0.7rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-transform: uppercase; text-decoration: none; transition: background-color 180ms ease, color 180ms ease; } .ds-pricing-link:hover { background: var(--background); color: var(--link); } .ds-pricing-link:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-blue); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Masthead Navigation
components.description: Compact uppercase links that wrap cleanly on narrow screens.
components.css: .ds-nav { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 1rem; } .ds-nav a { display: inline-flex; min-height: 2.75rem; align-items: center; color: var(--foreground); font: 600 0.7rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.12em; text-decoration: none; text-transform: uppercase; transition: color 180ms ease; } .ds-nav a:hover, .ds-nav a[aria-current='page'] { color: var(--link); } .ds-nav a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--brand-blue); outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Section Heading
components.description: Newsreader title, recurring geometric mark, and strong rule.
components.html: Section heading
components.css: .ds-section-heading { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 2.5rem minmax(0, 1fr); align-items: center; gap: 1.1rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--foreground); padding-bottom: 1.15rem; color: var(--foreground); } .ds-section-heading svg { width: 2rem; height: 2rem; } .ds-section-heading h2 { margin: 0; font: 540 clamp(2.25rem, 4.5vw, 4.5rem)/0.98 'Newsreader Variable', Georgia, serif; letter-spacing: -0.04em; }

components.name: Hero Image Field
components.description: Abstract geometric placeholder field, never a substitute for real portfolio imagery.
components.html: IMAGE HERE
components.css: .ds-hero-art { position: relative; display: grid; min-height: 24rem; place-items: center; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--foreground); background: var(--brand-blue); } .ds-hero-art::before { position: absolute; top: -12%; right: -9%; width: 78%; aspect-ratio: 1; border: 1px solid rgb(255 255 255 / 62%); border-radius: 50%; content: ''; } .ds-hero-art span { position: relative; z-index: 1; display: grid; width: 58%; min-height: 55%; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--foreground); background: var(--background); color: var(--link); font: 700 0.7rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }

components.name: Gallery Placeholder
components.description: Wide, square-cornered tile for future approved portfolio imagery.
components.html: IMAGE HERE
components.css: .ds-gallery-tile { display: grid; aspect-ratio: 3 / 2; min-width: 18rem; place-items: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); background: var(--muted); color: var(--link); font: 700 0.7rem/1.5 'Geist Variable', sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.16em; }

narrative.overview: The portfolio uses the pacing and clear hierarchy of a mid-century magazine: expressive display type, precise rules, open space, and one recurring frame-and-signal mark. White, ink black, and the specified blue carry the identity across both themes. The image fields remain explicitly marked placeholders until real portfolio material is supplied.
keyCharacteristics: High-contrast Newsreader headlines paired with practical Geist text.
Square-edged geometry, thin rules, and a recurring black-and-blue mark.
Blue #0077b6 used as a focal color and as a single full-width contact section.
Placeholder portfolio material remains visibly unverified.

rules.name: The One Signal Rule
rules.body: Keep the confirmed blue as the sole saturated accent; use neutral surfaces to give it hierarchy.

rules.name: The Two-Voice Rule
rules.body: Use Newsreader for display hierarchy and Geist for utility text; do not use the display face for dense copy.

rules.name: The Rule-Not-Shadow Rule
rules.body: Use borders and surface changes for separation; do not add ambient shadows to editorial content.

dos: Do use #0077b6 as the primary accent and preserve its high-contrast white pairing.
Do maintain the frame-and-signal mark, editorial rules, and deliberate negative space.
Do keep the mobile reading order and preserve reduced-motion support for the carousel.
Do leave current copy and imagery visibly provisional until approved replacements arrive.
donts: Don't add extra saturated colors or gradients.
Don't introduce rounded card stacks or shadow-heavy containers.
Don't present placeholder clients, results, testimonials, pricing, or images as verified facts.
